# Thunderbird Development Dashboard stuck quit and restart

`desktop/main.cjs` starts a separate backend service; normal quit waits for `backend.stop()`. `commands/desktop.mjs` prepares the runtime and writes logs under `~/.tb-tools/desktop-logs/`. [Task 1][Task 2]

Scope: general.
